{{Quote|Attention, Abeloth's fleet. We are under attack by the Lost Tribe of Sith. Coordinates to our next destination have been downloaded to each of your vessels. We will rendezvous there.|Gavar Khai|<ref name="FJ8" />}}
In [[44 ABY]], '''Abeloth's fleet''' was formed by members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] that defected from the Tribe to join the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. Led by [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], they [[Destruction of Tahv|defended]] Abeloth in the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] when she fled after wreaking havoc on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]].
